name: Hausa
source_note: Team draft translation; awaiting native-speaker review.

instructions.wait_here: Don Allah ku jira a nan
instructions.please_stand: Don Allah ku tashi tsaye, ku shirya tafiya
instructions.keep_moving: Don Allah ku ci gaba da tafiya
instructions.slight_delay: Ɗan jinkiri kaɗan, mun gode da haƙurinku
instructions.keep_pass_ready: Ku riƙe katin rukuninku a shirye
instructions.no_photography: Don Allah kada ku ɗauki hoto
instructions.elderly_priority: Fifiko ga tsofaffi da masu naƙasa
instructions.prepare_now: Ku shirya, shiga cikin kusan minti 10
instructions.time_inside_limited: Lokaci a cikin Rauda yana da iyaka ga kowa

preparation.title: 'Yan mintuna kafin shiga
lines: Ku shiga a natse. Lokacinku a tsare yake.
Ku ci gaba da tafiya tare da rukuninku, kada ku tsaya a hanyoyi.
Ku gaisar da Annabi ﷺ da sahabbansa biyu, Abubakar da Umar, a ƙasan murya.
Lokaci a cikin Rauda yana da iyaka ga kowa; ku taƙaita addu'arku da gaskiya.
Ba a ɗaukar hoto a ciki. Waya a aljihu.
Ku bi alamun shiru na ma'aikata.
preparation.greeting_ar: السلام عليك يا رسول الله ورحمة الله وبركاته. السلام عليك يا أبا بكر الصديق. السلام عليك يا عمر بن الخطاب.
preparation.greeting: Assalamu alaika ya Rasulallah wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh. Assalamu alaika ya Aba Bakr as-Siddiq. Assalamu alaika ya Umar ɗan Khattab.
preparation.source: Daga jagororin da Hukuma ta buga game da ziyarar Rauda; kalmomin suna jiran nazarin Hukuma.

journey.t24: Ziyararku zuwa Rauda gobe ce da ƙarfe {slot}. Ƙofarku: {gate}. Wurin taruwarku: {point}. Ku tashi daga yankin {hotel_area} wajen ƙarfe {depart} (kusan minti {walk_min} na tafiya a hankali). Lokacinku a tsare yake cikin tazararku; babu buƙatar gaggawa.
journey.t90: Nan da kusan minti 90: lokacinku ƙarfe {slot} ne. Ku tashi da ƙarfe {depart} zuwa {gate}, sannan zuwa wurin taruwa {point}. Ku ɗauki ruwa da izininku, ku yi tafiya a hankali.
journey.t30: Nan da kusan minti 30: lokacinku ƙarfe {slot} ne. Don Allah ku nufi wurin taruwa {point} kusa da {gate} yanzu. A wurin dubawa za a karanta izininku sau ɗaya; sannan ku ci gaba tare da rukuninku.
journey.protected_note: Ku zo cikin tazararku; idan kun makara, mai kula zai saka ku a rukuni na gaba.

ui.tagline: Lokacinku a tsare yake, ku yi tafiya a hankali
ui.pass_hint: Ku nuna wannan lambar ga ma'aikata a kowane wuri. Yana aiki ba tare da intanet ba.
ui.basis_measured: daga lokutan da aka auna na rukunonin baya
ui.basis_simulated: daga lokutan kwaikwayo da aka bayyana
ui.basis_prior: babu aunawa tukuna: kewayon da aka bayyana
ui.no_instruction: Babu umarni a yanzu. Don Allah ku jira a natse.
ui.showme_hint: Ku taɓa kati, sannan ku nuna wa ma'aikaci
ui.inside_dark: Babu komai a allo a cikin Rauda
ui.after_exit: Ziyararku ta kammala. Allah ya karɓa.
ui.protected_until: Rukuninku a tsare yake har zuwa {time}
ui.enter_hint: Duba lambar rajista ko liƙa rubutun katin
ui.offline: Ba a kan layi: ana nuna yanayin ƙarshe da aka sani
ui.sim_banner: Bayanan izini na kwaikwayo da aka bayyana
ui.no_pass_yet: Babu katin rukuni tukuna. Don Allah ku je wurin rajista.
